text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Wel... come. How many—... How many 
guests, in your party?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Under... stood. I will... guide you to 
your seat.

One day, I went to check on Symboli Kris 
S, who was working a short-term part-time 
job at a family restaurant. The reason 
being—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The Professor and I... are alike. Both 
striving to fulfill our mission 
together...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—I want to follow her example. Standing 
up against adversity—just like her.

Based on my experience at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival the other day, I 
concluded that the service industry is 
optimal for honing communication skills. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: For Table 9—this.

text_block_list.name: Serving Robot
text_block_list.text: "Understood-woof!"

text_block_list.name: Serving Robot
text_block_list.text:
"Your order has arrived, woof. Please take 
it from the tray, woof."

"...This family restaurant had serving 
robots deployed. With this, there would be 
few opportunities for customer service."
choice_data_list:
I wonder if this'll be good "training" for 
my communication skills...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Unununu! I can't decide! I can't 
deciiiide!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Crispy grilled spicy chicken" and "tomato 
pizza with plenty of cheese"...! My 
companions for cola this time are...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Both look delicious, so it's hard to 
choose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――How may I help you? ――No Reason, 
Durandal.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Kris S-dono! What treats dost thou 
deem fitting for cola?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Chicken and pizza—both are—good pairings. 
However, what I recommend is... banana 
yogurt.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh? Banana yogurt?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This shop's cola is—strongly 
carbonated. Hence, the mellowness of the 
yogurt—stands out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Also, cola and banana... surprisingly, go 
well together. The combination of 
carbonation and yogurt—can be expected—to 
aid, digestion.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see. Recommending it from a health 
perspective is so very like you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, thanks to you, the feast is 
settled! Lady Kris S, you have done 
splendidly!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"My pleasure――It was an honor to be of 
service."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. —Would you care for—more 
water?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
My, I was just about to ask for that. 
You're quite attentive, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――You flatter me.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: You... umm...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. —Thank... you. —I'm... 
happy... for the compliment.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... ufufu. How polite of you, thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer. For making you keep 
me company... during my break.
choice_data_list:
No. More importantly, looks like you're 
working hard.

No. More importantly, looks like you've 
been working hard.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. —Choosing this place—was the right 
decision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"With robots handling the food 
delivery――it is clear. How 'we', the 
part-timers――should do our jobs."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Sensing needs—powers of observation... 
Tailoring to the person—choice of words...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Through my work—I can feel it. Those 
skills—being polished.

It seems she felt a solid sense of 
progress. Any doubts about whether it 
would serve as training turned out to be 
needless worry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. It is about time... for me 
to go.

Symboli Kris S briskly returned to her 
work. I cheered her on as she did.
